text:
# filter.fulltext

TL;DR:
- filter.fulltext is the broad buyer text search field.

What it means:
- It searches listing content in a buyer-facing way rather than doing exact identifier matching.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the user describes what they want in natural terms but does not know a listing id.
